subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media-aware batching work be a LINE/plugin-owned opt-in buffer, a generic channel SDK/gateway coalescer, or deferred in favor of narrow per-channel fixes?
rationale: The remaining gap requires choosing the owner boundary, config surface, default latency, batching keys, command bypass behavior, and channel-specific reply-token semantics before a safe fix PR can be scoped.

options.title: Plugin-owned opt-in buffers
options.body: Add a documented plugin/SDK pattern and implement LINE-style media batching in the owning channel plugin without changing global gateway behavior by default.

options.title: Generic gateway coalescer
options.body: Design a shared gateway-level media coalescer with explicit SDK contracts, config, command bypass, upgrade proof, and channel capability tests before implementation.

options.title: Defer broad batching
options.body: Keep current text debounce and Telegram album support, and track only concrete channel-specific media-loss bugs such as WhatsApp separately.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned opt-in buffers
recommendation.body: Add a documented plugin/SDK pattern and implement LINE-style media batching in the owning channel plugin without changing global gateway behavior by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on the shared inbound debounce/config/plugin boundary where recent current-main history points most strongly to this contributor.
